Fairhope has plenty more room for more subdivisions. My water pressure is fine and we are getting some good football players in the new apartments so y'all forget that has benefits. Drainage is good and the sewer updates are kicking in across the Bayside. Fishing at the pier has been great for the last few years. Fairhope schools are above average and we are just better than Foley and Gulf shores if you get down to it. If you don't like it put your house for sale and cash out and move somewhere else..somebody will gladly trade your place!! So quit complaining Fairhope could be worse.
I forgot all about the football players.
We can't let Gulf shores win a state title and not try to compete at the same level. It is about pride. And economic development. People love a good ball team on Friday nights
Building more can't make it any worse can it?
Fairhope is fine. Nothing to see here.
